title: Repair Staging convergence diagnostics and Runtime DB semantic readiness wiring

phases.objective: Keep Staging Doctor and One-Click convergence diagnostics exact-current while wiring deployment-info semantic readiness to the Runtime DB without crossing the Runtime Persistence DB boundary.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run Staging Doctor/One-Click diagnostics and query /deployment-info?include_platform_admin_semantic_readiness=1 on the exact candidate.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Diagnostics parse safely, shared convergence preflight is refreshed when stale, and semantic readiness reads workspace_registry through the Runtime DB while Runtime Persistence remains separate.
steps: Validate the Staging Doctor git-command guard and operations logging contract.
Refresh the shared read-only convergence preflight when the current schema/governance evidence is missing, stale, or non-exact.
Resolve /deployment-info through the deployment composition root with the Runtime DB read dependency.
Keep Runtime Persistence DB wiring separate from workspace_registry semantic readiness.
Verify exact-current frontend and Remote MCP generated evidence.
Require live Staging certification before any promotion decision.
assertions: Staging Doctor PowerShell command detection is syntactically valid and guarded.
One-Click convergence uses exact-current read-only evidence before plan creation.
deployment-info semantic readiness performs the bounded Runtime DB workspace_registry read.
Runtime Persistence DB is not substituted for Runtime DB semantic readiness.
Production deployment, Production mutation, provider mutation, DNS mutation, credential mutation, database mutation, and grant widening are not authorized.
